widgets_values:
功能说明：
1、自动抠图，抠衣服。
2、自动抠图，识别人物身体和衣服区域。
3、把扣下来的衣服穿到人物的身体区域。


默认是自动蒙版，自动抠图。


可以开启手动蒙版，然后精确人工手动涂抹蒙版。
可实现只换上衣或者只换裤子。


当扣下来的衣服，和目标区域不够匹配时（比如区域宽度差别太大，或者高度差别太大）
请使用手动蒙版，手动画目标区域蒙版，来获得更好的结果。
请仅描述图片的背景情况，描述详尽，请勿提及其他任何内容。第一句话是：这张照片的背景是，返回200个字左右，结果用英文输出

Please provide a detailed description of this image. If any characters in the image are familiar to you, such as celebrities, movie characters, or animated figures, please directly use their names. The description should be as detailed as possible, but should not exceed 200 words.

Please provide a detailed description of this image. If any characters in the image are familiar to you, such as celebrities, movie characters, or animated figures, please directly use their names. The description should be as detailed as possible, but should not exceed 200 words.

Please provide a detailed description of this image. If any characters in the image are familiar to you, such as celebrities, movie characters, or animated figures, please directly use their names. The description should be as detailed as possible, but should not exceed 200 words.
Dress the figure in the right image in the clothes from the left image，
请描述这些衣物的内容、材质和款式，描述详尽，返回第一句话是：她（或者他）正穿着这些衣服，而这些衣服的特点是：，返回200个字左右，结果用英文输出
描述这个角色的发型、头饰、体型、姿势和动作，描述详尽。不要描述其服装。第一句话是：“一位女性(或者男性)是……”，返回200个字左右，结果用英文输出
